title: Losing Two People
description:
Hello friend! 👋

So everybody's heading back here. It's all about the team, man. Things felt a little weird today because I felt like we were losing two people, Michaela and Mike, as they were loading up all their gear. It's just what happens out here, I guess. I got to say goodbye to Bradley, and it was good to see him. He's keeping everyone motivated and laughing, and I hope our paths cross again. It's a good feeling to know you're alive, and it's even better when you can share it with people. Watching a big water fowl soar overhead was pretty amazing today, too.

This is day six. Everything is good.

Roll for veterans — I'll catch you next time.

title: I Almost Didn't Make It
description:
Hello friend! 🚴

I was with someone on the path and they asked me why I'm doing this. It's a good question, and I'm glad they asked. My answer always comes back to connecting with people and sharing the journey. It's moments like that, out on the road, where you really see the fabric of society. 

This ride is about more than just miles; it's about veterans and community. Team Red, White & Blue is doing incredible work connecting veterans through shared activity. I'm proud to support them and share their mission across the country. It's fun sharing this stuff, and I feel like Mr. Rogers sometimes – it's such a good feeling to know you're alive and connected.

Team Bravo salute — B in sign language, because the A-Team was taken by Hannibal and Mr. T. I appreciate all that service.

title: Four Guys from South Africa?
description:
Hello friend! ☀️

This is one of those moments you just can't make up. I was out here in Arizona, doing my thing, and I run into Barry. Barry's from South Africa, and then, wouldn't you know it, his friends Frank, Francois, and Dwayne show up. All from South Africa. And they're all living together, working this farm. It's wild.

They're growing all sorts of produce – cabbage, watermelons, onions, broccoli. And get this, they're also into model airplanes, kind of like drones. They fly them and even do target practice. It's definitely a different kind of life than I expected to find out here. They come here for about 10 months, then go home for two before coming back. Barry said he's been all over, Texas and Colorado too.

It's pretty amazing to see these kinds of connections happen out on the road. You never know who you're going to meet or what stories you'll hear. This is my purpose. I don't know how I found it, but... it's fun sharing this stuff.

Roll for veterans and I hope I'll see you out on the path.

title: Podcast Prep & a Windy Ride
description:
Hello friend! 🎙️

I'm halfway through my practice today and wanted to tell you a little bit about this podcast we're going to do. It's all about what you want to do, what you want to share with the public. We'll dive into big questions like the meaning of life, how someone can be so happy in a place full of sadness, what your purpose is, and even your favorite color – it can be anything!

I'm really excited to get to know you better and hear a bit about your life story. It's a little different, I think, and I'm sure people will like listening to it. It's very windy out here today, and I'm not sure what tomorrow will bring, but I'm planning to arrive a little early on Thursday to get everything set up so it's ready to go when you get here.

I'm not wearing my Invisalign right now because I'm eating a sandwich, so please forgive me. Okay, I'll see you on Thursday, and thank you very much for your time.

Roll for veterans.
